desc: Beregara’s B-14 Crest was built from the ground up to meet the demands of backcountry and mountain hunters, and comes equipped with a wide array of new and exclusive features. It utilizes a Monocoque Carbon Fiber Stock, which was developed using CF-RTM technologies originally developed for the aeronautics industry. The 100% carbon fiber stock features an internal spine that delivers superior strength and rigidity, making it virtually indestructible. The stock’s strength is perfectly matched by its ultra-lightweight, making the Crest ideal for any hunt that demands long hikes.
